purpose: G5 tau verification (docs/07_hypotheses_v2.md §1.2): G* with the budget enforced at the calibrated tau_kappa on the same 200 pilot episodes; pass if mean executed probe count is within n* +- 0.3. Only n_probes is read, which depends on G*'s own decision PF, so the evaluation PF is set to 2,000 particles to save compute (its outputs from this run are not used).
